Class AzureServiceBusReceiver<TBody, TConsumer>

Namespace
NuvTools.Notification.Messaging.Azure.ServiceBus
Assembly
NuvTools.Notification.Messaging.Azure.ServiceBus.dll

Background service for receiving and processing messages from Azure Service Bus queues or topic/subscriptions. The type of the message body to deserialize and process. The consumer type that implements IMessageConsumer<TBody> and handles the message. 

public abstract class AzureServiceBusReceiver<TBody, TConsumer> : AzureServiceBusReceiverBase<TBody, TConsumer>, IHostedService, IDisposable where TBody : class where TConsumer : IMessageConsumer<TBody>
